purpose: Corrected operations workbook capacity schema: capacity is driven by active Mark III / capture-capable unit count, not mission index.

fields.name: Mission_Code
fields.description: Mission shorthand such as M1, M2, M3.

fields.name: New_MarkIII_or_Capture_Units
fields.description: New Mark III or capture-capable units introduced in the mission. M1 may include active plus QA/spare split.

fields.name: New_MarkV_Tag_Companions
fields.description: Mark V tag/diagnostic companions introduced under the current serial plan.

fields.name: Cumulative_MarkIII_Serials
fields.description: Cumulative Mark III serial/build count carried by the operating plan.

fields.name: Active_Capture_Units
fields.description: Active Mark III/capture-capable units used for capacity modelling.

fields.name: Capacity_m3
fields.description: Active capture units multiplied by 1 m3 interface volume.

fields.name: Tag_Capacity_Asteroids
fields.description: Tagging capacity derived from active capture units and Mark V companion logic.

fields.name: PhaseII_Batch_Envelope
fields.description: Separate source-backed 3/5/7-unit batch envelope reference; not the sole capacity value.

fields.name: Batch_Interface_m3
fields.description: Interface capacity associated with the documented batch envelope where applicable.

fields.name: Redundancy_Logic
fields.description: Redundancy or fallback logic for the fleet state.

fields.name: Primary_Use
fields.description: Role of the mission row in the operations workbook.

fields.name: Source_Basis
fields.description: Document or memory basis for the row.

fields.name: Workbook_Route
fields.description: Downstream workbook surfaces that consume the row.

guardrails: Do not compute capacity from mission index.
Do not collapse Phase II 3/5/7 batch envelope into total active fleet count.
Do not promote Mark IV capacity without direct source evidence or explicit user override row.
